morehopqa_0.scope: Actual saved IDs/target suffix/EOS baseline and author cache hashes independently verified. Original author span/gold source and runtime remap receipts verified; tokenizer is not rerun locally.

MAS_decomposition.scope: Identity AP=abs(R-rho)=max(-rho,0)+abs(R-max(rho,0)), since R>=0. This is a CPU decomposition, not a clipped-attribution candidate. Negative density means the remaining signed attribution is negative; it does not by itself prove negative token contributions wrong. Raw scores are retained to detect genuine below-baseline responses hidden by the original clipping/envelope. Methods use their own deletion sets.

DT_raw_logprob_overprediction_at_negativ.formula: sum frozen signed DT scores over actual deleted positions - (raw clean logprob - raw deleted logprob). Positive is conditional deletion-effect overprediction, not a negative causal sign.

FT0.units_note: FT representation scores are not logprob finite multipliers; do not subtract their raw sum from a logprob drop as an equivalent-unit attribution error.

DT_costs.scope: Actual single-call diagnostic-inclusive attribution cost; not minibatch or warmed speed comparison.

FT_costs.scope: Entire unchanged original Both trace(hops3), including native identity probes and passive profile overhead; not isolated FT0 cost.

target_scope: Shared exact raw853-token input, original author fixed response+tokenizerEOS, eligible set and original full-response evaluator. Preserve original FT hop0 answer/sink representation and recursive all-generation policy versus existing DT full fixed-response logprob including EOS. These internal seeds/targets are not identical; do not change either method to pretend otherwise.

batch_scope.note: Multiple regression examples are separate native B1 workloads. EndpointsB2 are not a two-example minibatch; no throughput claim from these serial cases.

audit_scope: Original formulas, own FP32 density and masks, tie-aware original needle, source/input/receipt/count checks only. No GPU/model/tokenizer replay or FT/framework edits. Audit completion is not a quality-win criterion.
cost_scope: Same full model resident. One normal current DT,one original complete FT Both(hops3),42actual common FA scores. DT includes checkpoint/replay/endpoint copies and extra original finite FLA;FT includes all original eager attention,hybrid replays,24identity-valued FLA probes and all recursive hops,although onlyFT0 is scored. FT public trace time includes passive Python counts;DT normal diagnostics differ. Cold/single-call costs reported,not a fair steady FT0-only speed estimate. All load/init/compile/scoring/failure wall time retained. No zeroing/clipping/repair of official FT scores or framework exceptions.
